read_files

read_files.Rd

Helper function for preprocess(). Need not be run separately. Runs several checks to see if features file has required columns or if user-defined features file has been provided Two options are available for inputting feature list from the user. First, the file titled feature_list.txt must be present in the folder_path with the columns "ID", "mz" and "RT". Second, if an additional file titled Sample-and-feature-wise-RT-tolerance.txt is present, it should contain the same number of rows and double the number of columns (RT_min_ and RT_max_ for every sample) as feature_list.txt.

Usage

read_files(folder_path, tol_mz, tol_rt)

Arguments

folder_path:

same folder path used in preprocess(). The extracted fragment-grouped spectra in .txt format will be stored here

tol_mz:

mass tolerance (default: 0.05 Da)

tol_rt:

Rt tolerance (default: 0.1667 minutes)

Value

a list containing all MS2 spectra for every sample, an edited feature list file for subsequent steps and names of samples analyzed

Examples

# Example usage of the function
read_files(folder_path, 0.05, 0.1667)
#> Error in read_files(folder_path, 0.05, 0.1667): could not find function "read_files"
